items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: Bob Whitlock’s role was a necessity, much more so than he gets credit for

ctx.x: Yeah I mean there’s some of that. Chico and Gerry didn’t get along too well after Chico left. And you would think that years later they would have let that go. Well Gerry didn’t let things go very well. But Chico left the group to go with Lena Horne when the group had really hit you know. And Gerry just really kind of — you know Gerry would say that’s all in the past, but then when you really talked to him off the record he never — because to him they had created this very special thing and Chico was a major part…
that, it just — I think it just made it work because you know Chet’s role was a necessity, Bob Whitlock’s role was a necessity, much more so than he gets credit for, and of course Chico’s as well.
Was there a financial incentive to keep the group together? Sometimes we make assumptions that these groups that find a niche and create a sound that they’re being rewarded monetarily?
